title: Receipt
description: Cryptographically signed receipt proving a completed service session transaction

data.description: Base64-encoded OSPP Canonical Form of the receipt_fields object (offlineTxId, bayId, serviceId, startedAt, endedAt, durationSeconds, creditsCharged, meterValues, txCounter). See spec/06-security.md §4.8 for the canonicalization algorithm and §6.2 for the signing process.

signatureAlgorithm.description: Signature algorithm used to sign the receipt
